dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just keep your eyes on the pot.

dialogues.speaker: Ami
dialogues.text: Do I need to keep watching until it's done?

dialogues.speaker: Ami
dialogues.text: Um... That actually makes sense. If you don't pay attention, bugs might fly in, or you might overcook it.

dialogues.speaker: Ami
dialogues.text: Ah, cooking is so complicated! Why doesn't everyone just eat fresh fruits? They are so sweet and delicious!

dialogues.speaker: Ami
dialogues.text: That way, no one has to cook or worry about bugs and overcooking!
